entries.summary: Tool calls and replies show how long they took in whole seconds, minutes and hours, and anything under a second reads <1s instead of 0.0s.
Tool calls in the transcript show their name and icon, and their results appear as files, links, media and cards instead of raw JSON.

announcement.title: Clearer tool calls
